search.snippet: The steel longsword is a longsword that is stronger than the iron longsword, but weaker than the black longsword. Like all other steel weapons, it requires 5 Attack to wield.
search.title: Steel longsword - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Steel equipment are items made from steel metal. Steel equipment is stronger than iron equipment, but weaker than black equipment. All steel items are coloured light-grey. Steel armour requires 5 Defence to wield, weapons require 5 Attack.
